study_notes: Each period is the same representative week, with the period's load.
Candidates are one row per period (build_year = the period).
The island rows hold the steady island: grid-forming battery and diesel droop. They also keep the headroom the frequency check asks for: the largest load step, any one unit's trip and the PV lost.
The transition RoCoF limit is 2 Hz/s over 500 ms, a demo value relaxed from the data center's 1 Hz/s: the GFM settings recommender can then tune the batteries to meet it.
After a solve the investment case compares the plan with the island as it stands today (the existing diesels, PV, wind and battery, no grid), re-solved without the candidates.
